Usage: astryx search [options] <query...>

Search components, hooks, docs, templates, and themes in one ranked list

Options:
  --type <domain>  Filter to one domain (component|hook|doc|template|theme)
  --limit <n>      Max number of results, a positive integer (default 20)
  --verbose        Also print each result's score and match reason
  -h, --help       display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success (including zero matches)
  1  invalid --type, a --limit that is not a positive integer, or --type component, hook, or template where @astryxdesign/core cannot be found

Examples:
  # Ranked results
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 search button
  # Several words, no quotes
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 search dark mode --type doc
  # Filter + JSON
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 search "data table" --type template --json
  # Themes you can add
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 search warm --type theme

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/search
